raw_request: Initialize AppSDK governance for the existing HumanAgent repository without changing business source or project-owned rules.
understood_objective: Initialize AppSDK governance for HumanAgent's new governance module in an isolated worktree, preserving existing project owners, architecture, goals, and business source; this init does not claim AppSDK module coverage for HumanAgent business packages.
acceptance_criteria: AppSDK governance resources exist under HumanAgent without changing existing business source or AGENTS.md.

The AppSDK project contract records the new humanagent-governance module boundaries; existing HumanAgent business source remains owner-truth under project AGENTS.md and is not claimed as AppSDK module-bound by this init.
appsdk verify reports the initialized HumanAgent project contract as current and development-ready for the contract_bound initialization stage.
appsdk compile produces the project artifact from the initialized governance contract.
The resulting governance state is recorded on the isolated codex/gov-contract-humanagent worktree.
non_goals: No UI, provider, DSH, runtime, release, packaging, or deployment changes.
No rewrite, relocation, or semantic change of existing HumanAgent business source.
No replacement of HumanAgent's existing project AGENTS.md, owner map, architecture, goals, or delivery gates.
No AppSDK module coverage claim for existing HumanAgent business packages in this initialization step.
No merge, push, or remote publication in this initialization step.
No Collab, Guide, bug, task, or release state is fabricated when no live runtime evidence exists.
assumptions: The HumanAgent repository root is the AppSDK project root and project_root is '.'.
Existing source and documentation remain authoritative; AppSDK initialization only adds its own governance resources.
This is an isolated non-main worktree based on origin/main HEAD 5fb25ee0955a65ba77f90a6642921a5cf85524d5.
risk_decisions: AppSDK governance is initialized as a project_refactor, not as a rewrite of the existing HumanAgent implementation.
The existing project AGENTS.md and business source remain the owner truth; AppSDK only adds machine-checkable governance resources.
Compile is bound to the repository's existing typecheck command instead of a placeholder module build.
